Payments Exams Banner
fields.options:
What does this tab control?
Re Exam — Show or hide the Re-Examination menu in the student portal sidebar. Enable counter payment to let students register via cash at the counter.
Improvement Exam — Show or hide the Improvement Exam registration option on student results. Enable counter payment for cash-at-counter registration.
Fees & Payments — Toggle the “Pay at Counter” button on the student fees page alongside online payment.
Documents Page — Control whether students can see their uploaded documents (Aadhaar, marksheets, etc.) on the Documents & Downloads page.

fields.description: Control Re Exam menu visibility and payment options in the student portal
fields.label: Re Exam

fields.description: Show the Re Exam menu item in the student portal sidebar. Disable to hide it from all students.
fields.label: Enable Re Exam Menu

fields.description: Allow students to register for re-exam by selecting cash payment at the counter. Uncheck to hide the Pay at Counter button.
fields.label: Enable Counter Payment (Re Exam)

fields.description: Print Format used when students download their Re-Exam payment receipt. Leave blank to use the default 'Re Exam Receipt'.
fields.label: Re Exam Receipt Print Format

fields.description: Control Improvement Exam menu visibility and payment options in the student portal
fields.label: Improvement Exam

fields.description: Show the Improvement Exam registration button on the student results page. Disable to hide it from all students.
fields.label: Enable Improvement Exam Registration

fields.description: Allow students to register for improvement exam by selecting cash payment at the counter. Uncheck to hide the Pay at Counter button.
fields.label: Enable Counter Payment (Improvement Exam)

fields.description: Print Format used when students download their Improvement Exam payment receipt. Leave blank to use the default 'Improvement Exam Receipt'.
fields.label: Improvement Exam Receipt Print Format

fields.description: Control payment options available to students on the Fees & Payments page
fields.label: Fees & Payments

fields.description: Show a Pay at Counter (Cash) option on the Fees & Payments page alongside online payment. Uncheck to hide the counter payment button.
fields.label: Enable Counter Payment (Fees)

fields.description: Control what is visible on the Documents & Downloads page
fields.label: Documents Page

fields.description: Show the student's own uploaded documents (Aadhaar, PAN, marksheets, etc.) on the Documents page
fields.label: Show Uploaded Documents Section
Reminders Action Banner
fields.options:
Send Reminders Manually
To send fee reminders to students now, click Actions › Send Fee Reminders in the top-right corner. You can filter by Program, Academic Year, and Reminder Type before sending.

fields.description: Configure automated fee reminder emails sent to students before and after their payment due dates
fields.label: Fee Reminder Settings

fields.description: Master switch — uncheck to disable all fee reminder emails. Individual reminders below can also be toggled independently.
fields.label: Enable Fee Reminders

fields.description: Sender name shown in the reminder emails (e.g. Finance & Accounts Office)
fields.label: Sender Name

fields.description: Sender email for all fee reminders (e.g. finance@nlsiu.ac.in). Must be configured as an outgoing Email Account in Frappe. Leave blank to use the site default.
fields.label: Sender Email

fields.description: Send a reminder email 7 days before the fee due date
fields.label: Enable 7-Day Reminder

fields.description: Email Template used for the 7-day advance reminder. The template can use {{ student_name }}, {{ fee_head }}, {{ outstanding_amount }}, {{ due_date }} variables.
fields.label: Email Template

fields.description: Send a final reminder email 1 day before the fee due date
fields.label: Enable 1-Day Reminder

fields.description: Email Template used for the 1-day final reminder. The template can use {{ student_name }}, {{ fee_head }}, {{ outstanding_amount }}, {{ due_date }} variables.
fields.label: Email Template

fields.description: Send an overdue notice email after the fee due date has passed
fields.label: Enable Overdue Notice

fields.description: Number of days after the due date to send the overdue notice (e.g. 3 = send 3 days after due date)
fields.label: Days After Due Date

fields.description: Email Template used for the overdue notice. The template can use {{ student_name }}, {{ fee_head }}, {{ outstanding_amount }}, {{ due_date }} variables.
fields.label: Email Template

fields.description: Controls the "Continue with Google" option on the student login page
